metadata.title: LifeNavigator-AI Complete Government Scheme Catalogue Reference

schemes.name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC) Scheme
schemes.department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
schemes.description: Institutional credit facility designed to meet the production credit requirements of farmers, allied activities, fisheries, and animal husbandry at concessional interest rates.
schemes.beneficiaries: farmers, individual cultivators, tenant farmers, fishers, dairy farmers
schemes.benefit: Revolving credit limit for cultivation and allied activities with 7% interest rate, reduced to 4% per annum upon prompt repayment with interest subvention.
schemes.eligibility: Groups: farmers, individual cultivators
schemes.application_process: Submit one-page KCC application form at commercial banks, RRBs, cooperative societies, or apply via the PM-KISAN portal's KCC module.
schemes.source_name: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare — KCC Portal

schemes.name: Krushak Assistance for Livelihood and Income Augmentation (KALIA, Odisha)
schemes.department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers' Empowerment
schemes.description: Comprehensive welfare scheme launched by Government of Odisha to support small and marginal farmers and landless agricultural households.
schemes.beneficiaries: small and marginal farmers, landless agricultural labourers, vulnerable agricultural households
schemes.benefit: Direct financial assistance of ₹4,000 per year for small and marginal farmers, and ₹12,500 one-time livelihood assistance for landless agricultural households.
schemes.eligibility: Groups: small and marginal farmers, landless agricultural labourers
schemes.application_process: Apply online at kalia.odisha.gov.in or submit green application forms at Gram Panchayat nodal offices.
schemes.source_name: Government of Odisha — KALIA Portal

schemes.name: Mission for Integrated Development of Horticulture (MIDH)
schemes.department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
schemes.description: Centrally sponsored scheme for holistic growth of the horticulture sector covering fruits, vegetables, root and tuber crops, mushrooms, spices, and flowers.
schemes.beneficiaries: horticulture farmers, FPOs, entrepreneurs
schemes.benefit: Capital subsidy up to 40%–50% for polyhouses, shade nets, cold storage, post-harvest infrastructure, and nursery establishment.
schemes.eligibility: Groups: horticulture farmers, FPOs
schemes.application_process: Submit project proposal through the State Horticulture Mission / District Horticulture Office.
schemes.source_name: MIDH National Portal

schemes.name: National Agriculture Market (e-NAM)
schemes.description: Pan-India electronic trading portal that networks existing APMC mandis to create a unified national market for agricultural commodities.
schemes.beneficiaries: farmers, traders, farmer producer organisations
schemes.benefit: Transparent price discovery through electronic bidding, assaying facilities, access to buyers nationwide, and direct digital settlement into farmer accounts.
schemes.eligibility: Groups: farmers, traders
schemes.application_process: Register online at enam.gov.in as a farmer or through the gate entry registration desk at any linked e-NAM APMC mandi.
schemes.source_name: e-NAM Official Portal

schemes.name: National Livestock Mission (NLM)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry and Dairying
schemes.department: Department of Animal Husbandry and Dairying
schemes.description: Sustainable development of the livestock sector focusing on poultry, sheep, goat, and piggery entrepreneurship, feed and fodder development.
schemes.beneficiaries: livestock farmers, individual entrepreneurs, SHGs, FPOs
schemes.benefit: Capital subsidy up to 50% (up to ₹50 lakh for poultry, ₹50 lakh for sheep/goat breeding farms, and ₹30 lakh for piggery farms).
schemes.eligibility: Groups: livestock farmers, individual entrepreneurs
schemes.application_process: Register and apply online on the NLM portal through SIDBI Udyamimitra platform with bank loan sanction.
schemes.source_name: Department of Animal Husbandry and Dairying — NLM

schemes.name: Paramparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana (PKVY)
schemes.department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
schemes.description: Sub-component of National Mission on Sustainable Agriculture promoting organic farming through cluster-based approaches and Participatory Guarantee System (PGS) certification.
schemes.beneficiaries: farmers, organic farming groups, farmer clusters
schemes.benefit: Financial assistance of ₹50,000 per hectare over 3 years, of which ₹31,000 is directly provided for organic inputs, biological fertilizers, and seeds.
schemes.eligibility: Groups: farmers, organic farming groups
schemes.application_process: Farmers form a cluster of at least 20 hectares/50 farmers and register with Regional Councils or District Agriculture Officers.
schemes.source_name: PGS-India Organic Certification Portal

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
schemes.department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
schemes.description: Comprehensive yield-based crop insurance scheme providing financial support and risk cover to farmers against non-preventable natural risks from pre-sowing to post-harvest.
schemes.beneficiaries: farmers, sharecroppers, tenant farmers cultivating notified crops
schemes.benefit: Low actuarial premium rates (maximum 2% for Kharif crops, 1.5% for Rabi food and oilseed crops, and 5% for annual commercial/horticultural crops) with government subsidy covering the rest.
schemes.eligibility: Groups: farmers, sharecroppers
schemes.application_process: Farmers can enroll through their lending bank branch for loanee farmers, or voluntarily via the PMFBY portal, CSCs, or authorized insurance intermediaries within the seasonal cut-off date.
schemes.source_name: PMFBY National Crop Insurance Portal

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)
schemes.department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
schemes.description: Central Sector scheme providing income support of ₹6,000 per year to eligible landholding farmer families across India through direct benefit transfer (DBT).
schemes.beneficiaries: farmers, landholding farmer families, small and marginal farmers
schemes.benefit: Income support of ₹6,000 per year in three equal instalments of ₹2,000 transferred directly into Aadhaar-seeded bank accounts.
schemes.eligibility: Groups: farmers, landholding farmer families
schemes.application_process: Apply online at the PM-KISAN portal under New Farmer Registration using Aadhaar and mobile number, or through local Common Service Centres (CSCs) and State Agriculture Nodal Officers.
schemes.source_name: PM-KISAN Official Portal

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Urja Suraksha evam Utthaan Mahabhiyan (PM-KUSUM)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy
schemes.description: Flagship scheme for de-dieselization of the farm sector and enhancing energy security through installation of standalone solar agriculture pumps and solarization of existing grid-connected agricultural pumps.
schemes.beneficiaries: farmers, panchayats, cooperatives, farmer producer organisations
schemes.benefit: Central financial assistance of up to 30% of the benchmark cost (with matching state share) for standalone solar pumps (Component B) and solarization of agricultural pumps (Component C).
schemes.eligibility: Groups: farmers, panchayats
schemes.application_process: Apply online through the respective State Renewable Energy Development Agency (SREDA) portal linked from the PM-KUSUM national portal.
schemes.source_name: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy — PM-KUSUM Portal

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana (PMKSY) — Per Drop More Crop
schemes.department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
schemes.description: Centrally sponsored scheme promoting micro-irrigation technologies (drip and sprinkler systems) to improve on-farm water use efficiency and productivity.
schemes.beneficiaries: farmers, small and marginal farmers, horticulturists
schemes.benefit: Capital subsidy up to 55% for small and marginal farmers and 45% for other farmers for installation of drip and sprinkler irrigation systems.
schemes.eligibility: Groups: farmers, small and marginal farmers
schemes.application_process: Apply through State Agriculture/Horticulture Department micro-irrigation portals or district horticulture offices.
schemes.source_name: PMKSY National Portal

schemes.name: Rashtriya Gokul Mission
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry and Dairying
schemes.department: Department of Animal Husbandry and Dairying
schemes.description: Nationwide scheme for genetic upgradation of bovine population, development and conservation of indigenous bovine breeds, and enhancement of milk production.
schemes.beneficiaries: dairy farmers, livestock entrepreneurs, cooperatives
schemes.benefit: Subsidy up to 50% (maximum ₹2 crore) for establishment of breed multiplication farms, free artificial insemination services, and IVF lab assistance.
schemes.eligibility: Groups: dairy farmers, livestock entrepreneurs
schemes.application_process: Applications for entrepreneurship components are submitted online via the national dairy/livestock portal or through State Livestock Development Boards.
schemes.source_name: Department of Animal Husbandry & Dairying — Rashtriya Gokul Mission

schemes.name: Silk Samagra 2 (Integrated Silk Development Scheme)
schemes.description: Central Sector Scheme implemented by Central Silk Board to enhance quality and productivity of indigenous silk production. Awaiting notification of latest operational cycle guidelines.
schemes.beneficiaries: sericulturists, silkworm rearers, silk reelers
schemes.benefit: Financial assistance and technology support up to 50% for mulberry plantation, rearing appliances, silkworm seed production, and reeling units.
schemes.eligibility: Groups: sericulturists, silkworm rearers
schemes.application_process: Applications processed through State Sericulture Directorates and Central Silk Board field stations; check latest operational guidelines.
schemes.source_name: Central Silk Board — Ministry of Textiles

schemes.name: Soil Health Card Scheme
schemes.department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
schemes.description: Government initiative providing periodic soil health cards to farmers with crop-wise nutrient recommendations to improve fertilizer use efficiency.
schemes.beneficiaries: farmers, cultivators
schemes.benefit: Free soil test report issued every 3 years containing nutrient status (12 parameters: N, P, K, S, Zn, Fe, Cu, Mn, Bo, pH, EC, OC) and customized dosage guidance.
schemes.eligibility: Groups: farmers, cultivators
schemes.application_process: Soil samples are collected by agriculture department extension staff; farmers can check status and download cards online.
schemes.source_name: Soil Health Card National Portal

schemes.name: Sub-Mission on Agricultural Mechanization (SMAM)
schemes.department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
schemes.description: Centrally sponsored scheme promoting inclusive farm mechanization, establishment of Custom Hiring Centres (CHCs), and subsidy on agricultural machinery.
schemes.beneficiaries: farmers, custom hiring entrepreneurs, self-help groups, FPOs
schemes.benefit: Subsidy ranging from 40% to 50% on cost of farm equipment (tractors, power tillers, rotavators, harvesters), with higher incentives for women, SC, ST, and small farmers.
schemes.eligibility: Groups: farmers, custom hiring entrepreneurs
schemes.application_process: Apply online at the agrimachinery.nic.in portal by selecting equipment type, dealer, and uploading land records.
schemes.source_name: Direct Benefit Transfer in Agriculture Mechanization Portal

schemes.name: ASPIRE (Scheme for Promotion of Innovation, Rural Industry and Entrepreneurship)
schemes.abbreviation: Scheme for Promotion of Innovation, Rural Industry and Entrepreneurship
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
schemes.description: Ministry of MSME scheme to set up a network of technology centres and incubation centres to accelerate entrepreneurship and promote start-ups for innovation in rural and agro-industry.
schemes.beneficiaries: rural entrepreneurs, agri-business startups, technical training institutions
schemes.benefit: One-time grant up to 100% of plant & machinery cost (max ₹1 crore) for government agencies and 50% (max ₹50 lakh) for private entities to establish Livelihood Business Incubators (LBIs).
schemes.eligibility: Groups: rural entrepreneurs, agri-business startups
schemes.application_process: Eligible technical and rural institutions apply online on the ASPIRE portal for establishment of LBI / TBI centres.
schemes.source_name: Ministry of MSME — ASPIRE Portal

schemes.name: Annal Ambedkar Business Champions Scheme (Tamil Nadu)
schemes.department: Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises Department
schemes.description: Tamil Nadu initiative providing comprehensive financial assistance to aspiring Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe entrepreneurs for starting manufacturing, service, or trading enterprises.
schemes.beneficiaries: Scheduled Caste entrepreneurs, Scheduled Tribe entrepreneurs
schemes.benefit: 35% capital subsidy on project cost up to ₹35 lakh, and 6% interest subvention for the entire loan repayment period.
schemes.eligibility: Age: 18 to 55 yrs; Groups: Scheduled Caste entrepreneurs, Scheduled Tribe entrepreneurs
schemes.application_process: Submit online application at msmeonline.tn.gov.in; sponsored to commercial banks or TIIC for project loan sanction.
schemes.source_name: Government of Tamil Nadu — MSME Portal

schemes.name: Credit Guarantee Fund Trust for Micro and Small Enterprises (CGTMSE)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
schemes.description: Joint initiative of Ministry of MSME and SIDBI providing collateral-free credit guarantee coverage to financial institutions lending to micro and small enterprises.
schemes.beneficiaries: micro enterprises, small enterprises, startups, women-led MSMEs
schemes.benefit: Guarantees credit facilities up to ₹5 crore per borrowing unit without third-party guarantee or collateral security, with guarantee coverage ranging from 75% to 85%.
schemes.eligibility: Groups: micro enterprises, small enterprises
schemes.application_process: Entrepreneurs apply for a business loan directly at any empaneled commercial bank, RRB, or NBFC requesting CGTMSE guarantee cover.
schemes.source_name: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises — CGTMSE

schemes.name: MSME Champions Scheme (MSME Sustainable ZED Certification)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
schemes.department: Quality Council of India / MSME Champions
schemes.description: Unified scheme providing financial support to MSMEs for adopting Zero Defect Zero Effect (ZED) manufacturing practices and international quality standards.
schemes.beneficiaries: manufacturing MSMEs, Udyam registered enterprises
schemes.benefit: Subsidy on ZED certification cost: 80% for Micro, 60% for Small, and 50% for Medium enterprises, with an additional 10% subsidy for women, SC, and ST entrepreneurs.
schemes.eligibility: Groups: manufacturing MSMEs, Udyam registered enterprises
schemes.application_process: Register on zed.msme.gov.in using Udyam Registration number, complete self-assessment, and apply for desktop/physical assessment.
schemes.source_name: Ministry of MSME — Champions Portal

schemes.name: New Entrepreneur-cum-Enterprise Development Scheme (NEEDS, Tamil Nadu)
schemes.department: Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises Department
schemes.description: Flagship scheme of Tamil Nadu MSME Department to assist educated youth to become first-generation entrepreneurs in manufacturing or service sectors.
schemes.beneficiaries: first generation entrepreneurs, educated youth, graduates and diploma holders
schemes.benefit: Capital subsidy of 25% of the project cost (up to ₹75 lakh) and 3% interest subvention during the entire tenure of the bank loan.
schemes.eligibility: Age: 21 to 35 yrs; Groups: first generation entrepreneurs, educated youth
schemes.application_process: Apply online at msmeonline.tn.gov.in/needs, followed by interview and selection by the District Task Force Committee headed by District Collector.
schemes.source_name: Government of Tamil Nadu — MSME Online Portal

schemes.name: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
schemes.description: Central Sector micro-credit scheme administered by MoHUA to facilitate affordable working capital loans to street vendors affected by economic disruption.
schemes.beneficiaries: street vendors, hawkers, thelawalas, urban roadside sellers
schemes.benefit: Collateral-free working capital loan of ₹10,000 (1st tranche), ₹20,000 (2nd tranche), and ₹50,000 (3rd tranche) with 7% interest subsidy on prompt repayment and cashback on digital transactions.
schemes.eligibility: Groups: street vendors, hawkers
schemes.application_process: Apply online at pmsvanidhi.mohua.gov.in or through Urban Local Body (ULB) / CSC with Certificate of Vending or Letter of Recommendation.
schemes.source_name: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs — PM SVANidhi

schemes.name: PM Vishwakarma
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
schemes.description: Central Sector Scheme providing end-to-end holistic support to traditional artisans and craftspeople who work with their hands and tools in 18 notified traditional trades.
schemes.beneficiaries: traditional artisans, blacksmiths, goldsmiths, potters, carpenters, tailors, cobblers, weavers
schemes.benefit: PM Vishwakarma Certificate & ID card, basic skill training of 5–7 days with ₹500/day stipend, modern toolkit incentive of ₹15,000, collateral-free enterprise credit up to ₹3 lakh at 5% interest, and digital transaction incentives.
schemes.eligibility: Age: 18 to Any yrs; Groups: traditional artisans, blacksmiths
schemes.application_process: Biometric-based registration at Common Service Centres (CSCs) across India, followed by three-stage verification (Gram Panchayat/ULB, District Implementation Committee, and Screening Committee).
schemes.source_name: Ministry of MSME — PM Vishwakarma Portal

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Formalisation of Micro Food Processing Enterprises (PMFME)
schemes.description: Centrally sponsored scheme launched under Aatmanirbhar Bharat Abhiyan to enhance the competitiveness of existing individual micro-enterprises in the unorganized food processing sector.
schemes.beneficiaries: micro food processors, farmer producer organisations, self-help groups, producer cooperatives
schemes.benefit: Credit-linked capital subsidy at 35% of eligible project cost with a maximum ceiling of ₹10 lakh per unit, seed capital of ₹40,000 per SHG member for working capital, and support for branding/marketing.
schemes.eligibility: Age: 18 to Any yrs; Groups: micro food processors, farmer producer organisations
schemes.application_process: Apply online at pmfme.mofpi.gov.in; applications are assisted by District Resource Persons (DRPs) for DPR preparation and bank loan sanction.
schemes.source_name: Ministry of Food Processing Industries — PMFME

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Formalisation of Micro Food Processing Enterprises Scheme (PMFME)
schemes.description: Ministry of Food Processing Industries scheme supporting formalisation and upgrading of micro food-processing enterprises, including group and common-infrastructure components. Current application windows and component guidelines should be confirmed on the official portal.
schemes.beneficiaries: micro food-processing enterprises, self-help groups, farmer producer organisations, cooperatives
schemes.benefit: Component-specific credit-linked, training, infrastructure, seed-capital or marketing support where available under current guidelines.
schemes.eligibility: Groups: micro food-processing enterprises, self-help groups
schemes.application_process: Refer to official portal
schemes.source_name: Ministry of Food Processing Industries — PMFME portal

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana (PMMY)
schemes.description: Flagship scheme to provide collateral-free institutional loans up to ₹20 lakh to non-corporate, non-farm small and micro enterprises across Shishu, Kishore, and Tarun categories.
schemes.beneficiaries: small business owners, shopkeepers, artisans, micro manufacturing units, women entrepreneurs
schemes.benefit: Collateral-free loans across categories: Shishu (up to ₹50,000), Kishore (₹50,001 to ₹5 lakh), Tarun (₹5 lakh to ₹10 lakh), and Tarun Plus (up to ₹20 lakh for previous repayers).
schemes.eligibility: Groups: small business owners, shopkeepers
schemes.application_process: Apply online via the Udyamimitra portal or directly at any commercial bank, Regional Rural Bank (RRB), Small Finance Bank, or MFI.
schemes.source_name: Department of Financial Services — PMMY

schemes.name: Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
schemes.description: Credit-linked subsidy programme administered by Ministry of MSME through KVIC to generate self-employment opportunities through establishment of micro-enterprises in non-farm sectors.
schemes.beneficiaries: prospective entrepreneurs, unemployed youth, SHGs, cooperative societies
schemes.benefit: Margin money subsidy of 25% (general) to 35% (special categories including women, SC, ST, OBC, PwD, minorities, NER) of project cost up to ₹50 lakh for manufacturing and ₹20 lakh for services.
schemes.eligibility: Age: 18 to Any yrs; Groups: prospective entrepreneurs, unemployed youth
schemes.application_process: Submit online application with project report at kviconline.gov.in; shortlisted proposals are sponsored to financing banks for sanction.
schemes.source_name: Khadi and Village Industries Commission — PMEGP e-Portal

schemes.name: Scheme of Fund for Regeneration of Traditional Industries (SFURTI)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
schemes.description: Ministry of MSME initiative to organize traditional artisans and craftspersons into clusters to make them competitive, market-driven, and sustainable.
schemes.beneficiaries: traditional artisans, khadi producers, coir clusters, artisan producer companies
schemes.benefit: Financial grant up to ₹2.5 crore for regular clusters (up to 500 artisans) and up to ₹5 crore for major clusters (more than 500 artisans) for Common Facility Centres (CFC), tools, and marketing.
schemes.eligibility: Groups: traditional artisans, khadi producers
schemes.application_process: Non-government organizations, SHG federations, or state agencies apply as Implementing Agencies (IAs) through the SFURTI web portal.
schemes.source_name: Ministry of MSME — SFURTI Portal

schemes.name: Stand-Up India Scheme
schemes.description: Department of Financial Services initiative facilitating bank loans between ₹10 lakh and ₹1 crore to at least one Scheduled Caste (SC) or Scheduled Tribe (ST) borrower and at least one woman borrower per bank branch.
schemes.beneficiaries: SC entrepreneurs, ST entrepreneurs, women entrepreneurs
schemes.benefit: Composite bank loan (including term loan and working capital) between ₹10 lakh and ₹1 crore for setting up greenfield enterprises in manufacturing, services, agri-allied, or trading.
schemes.eligibility: Age: 18 to Any yrs; Groups: SC entrepreneurs, ST entrepreneurs
schemes.application_process: Apply online at standupmitra.in or directly through any scheduled commercial bank branch.
schemes.source_name: Department of Financial Services — Stand-Up India

schemes.name: Unemployed Youth Employment Generation Programme (UYEGP, Tamil Nadu)
schemes.department: Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises Department
schemes.description: State credit-linked subsidy scheme to mitigate unemployment by establishing micro-enterprises in manufacturing, services, and business trades.
schemes.beneficiaries: unemployed youth, Class 8 pass youth
schemes.benefit: Subsidy of 25% of project cost (up to ₹2.5 lakh for manufacturing, ₹1.25 lakh for services, and ₹75,000 for business) with 7-day EDP training.
schemes.eligibility: Age: 18 to 35 yrs; Max income: Rs 500,000; Groups: unemployed youth, Class 8 pass youth
schemes.application_process: Apply online via msmeonline.tn.gov.in/uyegp; shortlisted candidates are interviewed by District Task Force Committee.
schemes.source_name: Government of Tamil Nadu — UYEGP Portal

schemes.name: Assistance to Persons with Disabilities for Purchase/Fitting of Aids/Appliances (ADIP)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
schemes.department: Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities (DEPwD)
schemes.description: Central Sector Scheme providing modern, standard aids and assistive appliances to persons with disabilities to assist them in overcoming limitations and achieving economic self-dependence.
schemes.beneficiaries: persons with disabilities, Divyangjan, children with special needs
schemes.benefit: Free or subsidized aids and appliances (hearing aids, battery-operated tricycles, wheelchairs, smart canes, Daisy players, prosthetics, artificial limbs) up to ₹15,000 per beneficiary.
schemes.eligibility: Groups: persons with disabilities, Divyangjan
schemes.application_process: Apply online at adip.depwd.gov.in or register at screening/distribution assessment camps organized by ALIMCO, National Institutes, or District Disability Rehabilitation Centres (DDRCs).
schemes.source_name: Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities — ADIP Scheme

schemes.name: Deendayal Disabled Rehabilitation Scheme (DDRS)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
schemes.department: Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities (DEPwD)
schemes.description: Central Sector Scheme providing grant-in-aid to voluntary organizations to enable persons with disabilities to access rehabilitation, special education, and vocational training.
schemes.beneficiaries: children and adults with disabilities, special educators, rehabilitation NGOs
schemes.benefit: Grant-in-aid covering up to 90% of project cost for special schools for children with hearing, visual, or intellectual impairment, vocational training centres, and community-based rehabilitation.
schemes.eligibility: Groups: children and adults with disabilities, special educators
schemes.application_process: Eligible voluntary organizations submit online proposals on the e-Anudaan portal recommended by State Government inspection committees.
schemes.source_name: Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities — DDRS

schemes.name: Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme (IGNDPS)
schemes.description: Sub-scheme under NSAP providing monthly pension to persons aged 18–79 years with severe or multiple disabilities living below the poverty line.
schemes.beneficiaries: persons with severe or multiple disabilities, BPL persons with disabilities
schemes.benefit: Monthly central pension of ₹300 per month (increased to ₹500/month at age 80+) with supplementary state top-ups ranging from ₹1,000 to ₹3,000 per month.
schemes.eligibility: Age: 18 to Any yrs; Groups: persons with severe or multiple disabilities, BPL persons with disabilities
schemes.application_process: Apply online at nsap.nic.in or at the District Social Welfare Office / BDO office.
schemes.source_name: NSAP Portal — IGNDPS

schemes.name: National Fellowship for Persons with Disabilities (NFPwD)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
schemes.department: Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities (DEPwD)
schemes.description: Central Sector Scheme providing fellowships to students with benchmark disabilities for pursuing full-time M.Phil. and Ph.D. degrees in Indian universities.
schemes.beneficiaries: research scholars with disabilities, M.Phil and Ph.D students
schemes.benefit: Monthly fellowship of ₹37,000 (Junior Research Fellow) and ₹42,000 (Senior Research Fellow) plus annual contingency allowance, escort allowance, and HRA.
schemes.eligibility: Groups: research scholars with disabilities, M.Phil and Ph.D students
schemes.application_process: Apply online through the dedicated fellowship portal or UGC/DEPwD notification with admission/registration proof in recognized university.
schemes.source_name: Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities — Fellowship

schemes.name: National Handicapped Finance and Development Corporation (NHFDC) Concessional Loans
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
schemes.department: National Divyangjan Finance and Development Corporation (NDFDC)
schemes.description: Apex corporation under DEPwD providing concessional loans and financial assistance for self-employment ventures, higher education, and assistive technology purchase.
schemes.beneficiaries: entrepreneurs with disabilities, PwD students, parents of persons with intellectual disabilities
schemes.benefit: Concessional term loans up to ₹50 lakh for self-employment enterprises and ₹20 lakh for education in India (₹40 lakh abroad) with interest rates ranging from 4% to 8% per annum.
schemes.eligibility: Age: 18 to 60 yrs; Groups: entrepreneurs with disabilities, PwD students
schemes.application_process: Apply through State Channelising Agencies (SCAs) or designated partner banks (such as Punjab National Bank, State Bank of India).
schemes.source_name: National Handicapped Finance and Development Corporation

schemes.name: Scheme for Implementation of Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act (SIPDA)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
schemes.department: Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities (DEPwD)
schemes.description: Scheme providing financial assistance to State Governments, UTs, and autonomous institutions to create barrier-free public environments and support accessible infrastructure.
schemes.beneficiaries: persons with physical disabilities, visually impaired citizens, elderly persons
schemes.benefit: Central grants to create accessible lifts, ramps, Braille signage, tactile paths in public buildings, government universities, hospitals, and accessible websites.
schemes.eligibility: Groups: persons with physical disabilities, visually impaired citizens
schemes.application_process: Proposals formulated and submitted by State Commissioners for Persons with Disabilities or heads of government educational/health institutions to DEPwD.
schemes.source_name: Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities — SIPDA

schemes.name: Tamil Nadu Maintenance Allowance for Differently Abled Persons
schemes.department: Welfare of Differently Abled Persons Department
schemes.description: State welfare scheme providing monthly maintenance allowance to persons with severe disabilities and mental retardation who cannot engage in gainful employment.
schemes.beneficiaries: persons with severe disabilities (75% and above), persons with intellectual disabilities, muscular dystrophy patients
schemes.benefit: Monthly financial allowance of ₹1,500 (enhanced up to ₹2,000 for severely bedridden beneficiaries) disbursed directly through bank accounts.
schemes.eligibility: Groups: persons with severe disabilities (75% and above), persons with intellectual disabilities
schemes.application_process: Apply through the District Differently Abled Welfare Officer (DDAWO) located at the District Collectorate.
schemes.source_name: Tamil Nadu Welfare of Differently Abled Persons Department

schemes.name: Unique Disability ID (UDID) Project
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
schemes.department: Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities (DEPwD)
schemes.description: National database creating a unified, digitized identity card and disability certificate for persons with disabilities, enabling transparent delivery of government welfare entitlements across all states.
schemes.beneficiaries: all persons with disabilities, Divyangjan
schemes.benefit: Smart card based national identity (UDID card) accepted pan-India, removing the need to carry multiple medical certificates across departments and public transport systems.
schemes.eligibility: Groups: all persons with disabilities, Divyangjan
schemes.application_process: Apply online at swavlambancard.gov.in, book an appointment at the nearest District Medical Board / Civil Hospital for disability assessment, and track card status.
schemes.source_name: Unique Disability ID Official Portal

schemes.name: Begum Hazrat Mahal National Scholarship
schemes.department: Maulana Azad Education Foundation / Ministry of Minority Affairs
schemes.description: Scholarship scheme for meritorious girl students belonging to economically weaker minority communities studying in Classes IX to XII.
schemes.beneficiaries: minority girl students, school students
schemes.benefit: ₹5,000 per annum for Classes IX and X; ₹6,000 per annum for Classes XI and XII.
schemes.eligibility: Max income: Rs 200,000; Groups: minority girl students, school students
schemes.application_process: Apply online on the National Scholarship Portal under Ministry of Minority Affairs.
schemes.source_name: National Scholarship Portal — Begum Hazrat Mahal

schemes.name: Chief Minister's Breakfast Scheme (Tamil Nadu)
schemes.department: Social Welfare and Nutritious Meal Programme Department
schemes.description: First-of-its-kind state initiative providing hot cooked wholesome breakfast to primary school children (Classes I to V) in all government schools.
schemes.beneficiaries: primary school students, children in Classes 1 to 5
schemes.benefit: Hot freshly prepared nutritious breakfast (such as upma, pongal, kichadi with vegetable sambar) on all school working days before classes begin.
schemes.eligibility: Groups: primary school students, children in Classes 1 to 5
schemes.application_process: Universal coverage for all enrolled students in government primary schools across Tamil Nadu; no application needed.
schemes.source_name: Government of Tamil Nadu Official Portal

schemes.name: Ishan Uday Special Scholarship Scheme for North Eastern Region
schemes.description: UGC special scholarship scheme for North Eastern Region students to promote higher education and improve gross enrollment ratio.
schemes.beneficiaries: North Eastern Region students, undergraduate students
schemes.benefit: ₹5,400 per month for general degree courses and ₹7,800 per month for technical/medical/professional courses for the entire course duration.
schemes.eligibility: Max income: Rs 450,000; Groups: North Eastern Region students, undergraduate students
schemes.application_process: Apply on the National Scholarship Portal with domicile certificate of NER States (Assam, Arunachal Pradesh, Manipur, Meghalaya, Mizoram, Nagaland, Sikkim, Tripura).
schemes.source_name: National Scholarship Portal — UGC Ishan Uday

schemes.name: Moovalur Ramamirtham Ammaiyar Higher Education Assurance Scheme (Pudhumai Penn)
schemes.department: Department of Social Welfare and Women Empowerment
schemes.description: Tamil Nadu flagship scheme providing monthly financial assistance to girl students who studied Classes VI to XII in government schools to pursue higher education.
schemes.beneficiaries: girl students in higher education, female college students
schemes.benefit: Monthly financial grant of ₹1,000 directly transferred to the girl student's bank account until successful completion of undergraduate degree/diploma/ITI.
schemes.eligibility: Groups: girl students in higher education, female college students
schemes.application_process: Apply online at pudhumaimaipen.tn.gov.in through the principal/nodal officer of the admitting college or institution.
schemes.source_name: Government of Tamil Nadu — Pudhumai Penn Portal

schemes.name: National Fellowship and Scholarship for Higher Education of ST Students
schemes.description: Ministry of Tribal Affairs scheme supporting Scheduled Tribe students for pursuing M.Phil/Ph.D. programmes and graduate/post-graduate studies in top institutions.
schemes.beneficiaries: Scheduled Tribe scholars, ST researchers, doctoral students
schemes.benefit: Fellowship of ₹37,000/month (JRF) / ₹42,000/month (SRF) plus contingency allowance, or full tuition fee reimbursement in top institutions.
schemes.eligibility: Groups: Scheduled Tribe scholars, ST researchers
schemes.application_process: Apply online on the fellowship.tribal.gov.in portal or via NSP.
schemes.source_name: Ministry of Tribal Affairs — Fellowship Portal

schemes.name: National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship Scheme (NMMSS)
schemes.department: Department of School Education and Literacy
schemes.description: Central Sector scholarship providing financial assistance to meritorious students from economically weaker sections to arrest dropouts after Class VIII.
schemes.beneficiaries: students, secondary school students, economically weaker students
schemes.benefit: Scholarship of ₹12,000 per annum (₹1,000 per month) for selected students studying in Classes IX to XII in government/aided schools.
schemes.eligibility: Max income: Rs 350,000; Groups: students, secondary school students
schemes.application_process: Apply online through the National Scholarship Portal (NSP) after qualifying in the State-level NMMSS selection test.
schemes.source_name: National Scholarship Portal — NMMSS

schemes.name: National Overseas Scholarship for SC Candidates
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
schemes.department: Department of Social Justice and Empowerment
schemes.description: Central Sector Scheme providing financial assistance to selected SC, de-notified nomadic tribes, and landless agricultural labourers for pursuing Master's and Ph.D. degrees abroad.
schemes.beneficiaries: Scheduled Caste scholars, postgraduate students, doctoral researchers
schemes.benefit: Full tuition fees, annual maintenance allowance (US$ 15,400 or £9,900), contingency allowance, visa fees, air passage, and medical insurance.
schemes.eligibility: Max income: Rs 800,000; Groups: Scheduled Caste scholars, postgraduate students
schemes.application_process: Apply online at nosmsje.gov.in during the annual application window with an unconditional offer letter from an accredited foreign university (top 500 QS ranking).
schemes.source_name: National Overseas Scholarship Online Portal

schemes.name: National Scholarship Portal — participating scholarships
schemes.description: Government scholarship discovery and application portal listing central and state schemes. This catalogue entry is a portal pointer; eligibility is scholarship-specific and must be checked in the current listing.
schemes.beneficiaries: students
schemes.benefit: Scholarship benefits vary by listed scheme; consult the current academic-year listing.
schemes.eligibility: Groups: students
schemes.application_process: Refer to official portal
schemes.source_name: National Scholarship Portal

schemes.name: PM POSHAN (Pradhan Mantri Poshan Shakti Nirman)
schemes.department: Department of School Education and Literacy
schemes.description: Centrally sponsored scheme providing hot cooked meals to eligible children enrolled in government and government-aided elementary schools (Classes I–VIII).
schemes.beneficiaries: school children, primary students, upper primary students
schemes.benefit: Nutritious hot cooked meals every school day meeting prescribed calorie (450 kcal for primary, 700 kcal for upper primary) and protein norms.
schemes.eligibility: Groups: school children, primary students
schemes.application_process: Automatic entitlement for all children enrolled in covered government, local body, and government-aided schools.
schemes.source_name: PM POSHAN Official Portal

schemes.name: PM-USP Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship for College and University Students (CSSS)
schemes.description: Merit-cum-means scholarship for top percentile college and university students from low-income families pursuing regular graduate and post-graduate studies.
schemes.beneficiaries: college students, university students, undergraduate students
schemes.benefit: ₹12,000 per annum for the first three years of undergraduate studies and ₹20,000 per annum at post-graduate level.
schemes.eligibility: Max income: Rs 450,000; Groups: college students, university students
schemes.application_process: Apply online at scholarships.gov.in by selecting Department of Higher Education under Central Schemes; must be in top 20th percentile in Class XII board results.
schemes.source_name: National Scholarship Portal — CSSS

schemes.name: Post-Matric Scholarship Scheme for Minorities
schemes.description: Central Sector scholarship providing financial assistance to minority students pursuing higher education from Class XI to Ph.D. level.
schemes.beneficiaries: minority students, college students
schemes.benefit: Admission and tuition fee reimbursement up to ₹10,000/year plus maintenance allowance up to ₹1,200/month.
schemes.eligibility: Max income: Rs 200,000; Groups: minority students, college students
schemes.application_process: Apply via the National Scholarship Portal under Ministry of Minority Affairs.
schemes.source_name: Ministry of Minority Affairs — Scholarship Schemes

schemes.name: Post-Matric Scholarship for SC Students
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
schemes.department: Department of Social Justice and Empowerment
schemes.description: Centrally sponsored scheme providing financial support to Scheduled Caste students studying at post-matriculation or post-secondary stages.
schemes.beneficiaries: Scheduled Caste students, post-matric students
schemes.benefit: Full non-refundable compulsory course fee reimbursement plus monthly academic maintenance allowance (up to ₹13,500/year depending on course group).
schemes.eligibility: Max income: Rs 250,000; Groups: Scheduled Caste students, post-matric students
schemes.application_process: Apply through the National Scholarship Portal or respective State DBT Scholarship Portal.
schemes.source_name: Department of Social Justice and Empowerment — Post Matric SC

schemes.name: Post-Matric Scholarship for ST Students
schemes.description: Centrally sponsored scheme providing financial assistance to Scheduled Tribe students pursuing recognized post-matriculation courses.
schemes.beneficiaries: Scheduled Tribe students, college students
schemes.benefit: Compulsory course fee reimbursement and monthly maintenance allowance paid directly via DBT.
schemes.eligibility: Max income: Rs 250,000; Groups: Scheduled Tribe students, college students
schemes.application_process: Apply through the National Scholarship Portal or State Tribal Welfare portal.
schemes.source_name: Ministry of Tribal Affairs — Scholarship Schemes

schemes.name: Pragati Scholarship Scheme for Girl Students
schemes.department: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE)
schemes.description: AICTE scheme providing financial assistance to meritorious girl students admitted to first year of technical degree or diploma programmes.
schemes.beneficiaries: female students, girl students in engineering and technology
schemes.benefit: ₹50,000 per annum for every year of study towards tuition fee, computer purchase, books, and competitive exam preparation.
schemes.eligibility: Max income: Rs 800,000; Groups: female students, girl students in engineering and technology
schemes.application_process: Apply online at the National Scholarship Portal under AICTE Schemes; maximum two girl children per family eligible.
schemes.source_name: National Scholarship Portal — AICTE Pragati

schemes.name: Pre-Matric Scholarship for SC Students (Classes IX and X)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
schemes.department: Department of Social Justice and Empowerment
schemes.description: Centrally sponsored scholarship to support children belonging to Scheduled Castes for studies in Classes IX and X to reduce dropout rates.
schemes.beneficiaries: Scheduled Caste school students, students in classes 9 and 10
schemes.benefit: Academic allowance of ₹3,500 per annum for day scholars and ₹7,000 per annum for hostellers studying in Classes IX and X.
schemes.eligibility: Max income: Rs 250,000; Groups: Scheduled Caste school students, students in classes 9 and 10
schemes.application_process: Apply online via State scholarship portal or NSP with school verification.
schemes.source_name: Department of Social Justice and Empowerment — Pre Matric SC

schemes.name: Saksham Scholarship Scheme for Specially Abled Students
schemes.department: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE)
schemes.description: AICTE initiative providing financial support to specially-abled students with not less than 40% disability pursuing technical degree or diploma courses.
schemes.beneficiaries: students with disabilities, technical education students
schemes.benefit: ₹50,000 per annum for each year of study towards tuition fees and academic expenses.
schemes.eligibility: Max income: Rs 800,000; Groups: students with disabilities, technical education students
schemes.application_process: Apply on the National Scholarship Portal under AICTE Schemes.
schemes.source_name: National Scholarship Portal — AICTE Saksham

schemes.name: Samagra Shiksha Abhiyan
schemes.department: Department of School Education and Literacy
schemes.description: Overarching programme for school education from pre-school to Class XII focusing on quality education, teacher training, and girl child empowerment.
schemes.beneficiaries: school students, elementary students, girl students
schemes.benefit: Free textbooks, free uniforms up to elementary level, transport allowance, Kasturba Gandhi Balika Vidyalayas, and composite school grants.
schemes.eligibility: Groups: school students, elementary students
schemes.application_process: Delivered universally through government and local authority schools without separate individual application.
schemes.source_name: Ministry of Education — Samagra Shiksha

schemes.name: Top Class Education Scheme for SC Students
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
schemes.department: Department of Social Justice and Empowerment
schemes.description: Central Sector Scholarship enabling meritorious Scheduled Caste students to pursue studies in notified premier institutions (IITs, IIMs, NITs, AIIMS, NLUs).
schemes.beneficiaries: Scheduled Caste students, premier institute students
schemes.benefit: Full tuition fee and non-refundable charges, living expenses allowance of ₹3,000/month, book grant of ₹5,000/year, and one-time computer grant up to ₹45,000.
schemes.eligibility: Max income: Rs 800,000; Groups: Scheduled Caste students, premier institute students
schemes.application_process: Apply on the National Scholarship Portal under Department of Social Justice and Empowerment.
schemes.source_name: Department of Social Justice and Empowerment — Top Class SC

schemes.name: Vidyalakshmi Education Loan Scheme
schemes.description: Single-window digital portal developed under the guidance of Ministry of Education to provide access to education loans and Central Sector Interest Subsidy (CSIS) schemes.
schemes.beneficiaries: students seeking education loans, higher education students
schemes.benefit: Single window platform to apply for education loans across scheduled commercial banks and claim full interest subsidy (CSIS) during the moratorium period for students with family income up to ₹4.5 lakh.
schemes.eligibility: Groups: students seeking education loans, higher education students
schemes.application_process: Register on vidyalakshmi.co.in, fill Common Educational Loan Application Form (CELAF), browse loan schemes and submit online to banks.
schemes.source_name: Ministry of Education — Vidyalakshmi Scheme

schemes.name: Aatmanirbhar Bharat Rojgar Yojana (ABRY)
schemes.description: Scheme launched as part of Atmanirbhar Bharat package to boost employment generation during recovery by subsidizing both employee and employer EPF contributions.
schemes.beneficiaries: formal sector job seekers, re-employed workers who lost jobs during pandemic
schemes.benefit: Government subsidy of 24% of wages (both 12% employees' and 12% employers' EPF contributions) for establishments employing up to 1000 employees.
schemes.eligibility: Max income: Rs 180,000; Groups: formal sector job seekers, re-employed workers who lost jobs during pandemic
schemes.application_process: Establishments register through EPFO unified portal with eligible Aadhaar-linked UANs of employees earning less than ₹15,000 per month.
schemes.source_name: Employees' Provident Fund Organisation — ABRY

schemes.name: Craftsmen Training Scheme (CTS / ITI)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship
schemes.description: Pioneering vocational training scheme conducted by Industrial Training Institutes (ITIs) across 150+ engineering and non-engineering trades to develop skilled technical workforce.
schemes.beneficiaries: youth, Class 8, 10, and 12 school leavers, technical trainees
schemes.benefit: Industry-recognized National Trade Certificate (NTC) awarded by NCVT, free or nominal-fee practical workshop training, and campus placement support.
schemes.eligibility: Age: 14 to Any yrs; Groups: youth, Class 8, 10, and 12 school leavers
schemes.application_process: Apply online through the respective State Directorate of Technical Education / ITI admission counseling portal.
schemes.source_name: Directorate General of Training — CTS

schemes.name: Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Scheme (MGNREGA)
schemes.description: Statutory legal guarantee of wage employment in rural areas, providing at least 100 days of guaranteed wage employment in a financial year to every rural household whose adult members volunteer to do unskilled manual work.
schemes.beneficiaries: rural adult citizens, rural unskilled workers, agricultural labourers, women workers
schemes.benefit: Guaranteed statutory wage employment for 100 days per household per year (with extra days in notified drought areas), with wages directly credited to bank/post office accounts.
schemes.eligibility: Age: 18 to Any yrs; Groups: rural adult citizens, rural unskilled workers
schemes.application_process: Apply for a Job Card in writing or orally at the local Gram Panchayat office; work must be provided within 15 days of demand or unemployment allowance is payable.
schemes.source_name: Ministry of Rural Development — MGNREGA Portal

schemes.name: National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme (NAPS)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship
schemes.description: Scheme to promote apprenticeship training and incentivize employers to engage apprentices, increasing youth employability through workplace exposure.
schemes.beneficiaries: vocational students, ITI passouts, graduates, diploma holders
schemes.benefit: Government sharing of 25% of prescribed stipend up to ₹1,500 per month per apprentice directly transferred via DBT to the apprentice's bank account.
schemes.eligibility: Age: 14 to Any yrs; Groups: vocational students, ITI passouts
schemes.application_process: Register as a Candidate on apprenticeshipindia.gov.in, search for apprenticeship opportunities, and sign contract with empaneled establishments.
schemes.source_name: Apprenticeship India Official Portal

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana 4.0 (PMKVY 4.0)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship
schemes.description: Flagship skill certification scheme of the Ministry of Skill Development & Entrepreneurship implemented through NSDC to enable Indian youth to take up industry-relevant skill training.
schemes.beneficiaries: unemployed youth, school and college dropouts, existing workers seeking upskilling
schemes.benefit: Free industry-aligned short term training (STT), Recognition of Prior Learning (RPL), modern Industry 4.0 courses, assessment, government certification, and placement assistance.
schemes.eligibility: Age: 15 to 45 yrs; Groups: unemployed youth, school and college dropouts
schemes.application_process: Register on the Skill India Digital Hub (SIDH) portal or visit any empaneled PMKVY Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Kendra (PMKK) with Aadhaar.
schemes.source_name: PMKVY Official Portal

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Rojgar Protsahan Yojana (PMRPY)
schemes.description: Scheme to incentivize employers for generation of new employment, wherein Government of India pays the full employer's contribution towards EPF and EPS for new employees.
schemes.beneficiaries: new wage earners earning up to ₹15,000/month, formal sector workers
schemes.benefit: Government of India pays 12% of the employer's contribution towards EPF and EPS for new eligible employees for a period of 3 years.
schemes.eligibility: Max income: Rs 180,000; Groups: new wage earners earning up to ₹15,000/month, formal sector workers
schemes.application_process: Employers register online at pmrpy.gov.in using their LIN (Labour Identification Number) and add eligible new employees with verified Aadhaar-seeded UAN.
schemes.source_name: Employees' Provident Fund Organisation — PMRPY

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Shram Yogi Maan-dhan (PM-SYM)
schemes.description: Central Sector voluntary and contributory pension scheme for unorganised workers for old-age protection and social security.
schemes.beneficiaries: unorganised workers, domestic workers, street vendors, rickshaw pullers, construction workers
schemes.benefit: Guaranteed minimum pension of ₹3,000 per month after attaining 60 years of age, with equal 50:50 matching contribution by the Government of India.
schemes.eligibility: Age: 18 to 40 yrs; Max income: Rs 180,000; Groups: unorganised workers, domestic workers
schemes.application_process: Enroll at any Common Service Centre (CSC) or self-enroll at maandhan.in with Aadhaar card and Savings bank account details.
schemes.source_name: Ministry of Labour and Employment — PM-SYM

schemes.name: Rural Self Employment Training Institutes (RSETI)
schemes.description: Three-way partnership between MoRD, State Governments, and Sponsor Banks providing free intensive skill and entrepreneurship training to rural youth with bank credit linkage.
schemes.beneficiaries: rural unemployed youth, BPL youth, women entrepreneurs
schemes.benefit: Completely free short-term skill development training with free boarding and lodging, followed by two years of handholding and bank loan linkage for enterprise setup.
schemes.eligibility: Age: 18 to 45 yrs; Groups: rural unemployed youth, BPL youth
schemes.application_process: Apply directly at the Lead Bank's RSETI centre located in the district headquarters.
schemes.source_name: Ministry of Rural Development — RSETI

schemes.name: Yuva Nidhi Scheme (Karnataka)
schemes.department: Department of Skill Development, Entrepreneurship and Livelihood
schemes.description: State guarantee scheme providing monthly unemployment allowance to educated youth who remain unemployed 180 days after graduation.
schemes.beneficiaries: unemployed graduates, unemployed diploma holders, youth residing in Karnataka
schemes.benefit: Monthly financial allowance of ₹3,000 for degree holders and ₹1,500 for diploma holders for up to 2 years or until gainful employment is found.
schemes.eligibility: Groups: unemployed graduates, unemployed diploma holders
schemes.application_process: Apply online through Seva Sindhu portal after completing the mandatory 180-day post-graduation waiting period without employment.
schemes.source_name: Government of Karnataka — Seva Sindhu

schemes.name: e-Shram Portal (National Database of Unorganised Workers)
schemes.description: Comprehensive national database created by Ministry of Labour and Employment to register and deliver social security entitlements to all unorganised workers across India.
schemes.beneficiaries: unorganised workers, migrant workers, gig and platform workers, street vendors, construction workers
schemes.benefit: Issuance of a 12-digit Universal Account Number (UAN) e-Shram card, accidental death/permanent disability cover of ₹2 lakh, and seamless linkage to central/state welfare schemes.
schemes.eligibility: Age: 16 to 59 yrs; Groups: unorganised workers, migrant workers
schemes.application_process: Self-register online at eshram.gov.in using Aadhaar-linked mobile number or visit any Common Service Centre (CSC) nationwide.
schemes.source_name: e-Shram National Database Portal

schemes.name: Fisheries and Aquaculture Infrastructure Development Fund (FIDF)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry and Dairying
schemes.description: Dedicated fund providing concessional finance to state entities, cooperatives, and private entrepreneurs for development of fisheries infrastructure.
schemes.beneficiaries: fisheries cooperatives, private entrepreneurs, state agencies
schemes.benefit: Interest subvention up to 3% per annum on term loans from nodal loaning entities (NABARD, NCDC, scheduled commercial banks).
schemes.eligibility: Groups: fisheries cooperatives, private entrepreneurs
schemes.application_process: Submit project proposal to Department of Fisheries / NABARD via the designated FIDF portal.
schemes.source_name: Department of Fisheries — FIDF

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry and Dairying
schemes.description: Flagship scheme for sustainable development of fisheries sector, infrastructure creation, modernizing cold chain, and empowering fishers.
schemes.beneficiaries: fishers, fish farmers, fish workers, fisheries cooperatives
schemes.benefit: Financial assistance up to 40% for general category and up to 60% for women, SC, and ST beneficiaries for fish farming units, biofloc, and marine boats.
schemes.eligibility: Groups: fishers, fish farmers
schemes.application_process: Submit individual or group applications through the PMMSY MIS portal or through District Fisheries Offices.
schemes.source_name: Department of Fisheries — PMMSY

schemes.name: Ayushman Arogya Mandir (Comprehensive Primary Health Care)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
schemes.description: Transformed sub-health centres and primary health centres delivering comprehensive primary health care covering maternal, child, non-communicable disease, and wellness services.
schemes.beneficiaries: all citizens, rural populations, urban poor
schemes.benefit: Free primary consultation, free essential drugs (172 medicines), free diagnostic tests (63 tests), tele-consultation via eSanjeevani, and wellness sessions.
schemes.eligibility: Groups: all citizens, rural populations
schemes.application_process: Walk into any nearby Ayushman Arogya Mandir or consult doctors online via eSanjeevani portal/app.
schemes.source_name: Ayushman Bharat Comprehensive Primary Health Care Portal

schemes.name: Ayushman Bharat — Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB-PMJAY)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
schemes.description: World's largest government-funded healthcare assurance scheme providing cashless secondary and tertiary hospitalization care to over 12 crore poor and vulnerable families.
schemes.beneficiaries: vulnerable families, low income households, senior citizens aged 70 and above, rural poor
schemes.benefit: Health cover of up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year on a family floater basis with cashless and paperless access at empaneled public and private hospitals.
schemes.eligibility: Groups: vulnerable families, low income households
schemes.application_process: Verify eligibility online using mobile/Ration card at beneficiary.nha.gov.in or visit any empaneled hospital / CSC with Aadhaar and Ration Card to generate an Ayushman Card.
schemes.source_name: National Health Authority — PM-JAY

schemes.name: Biju Swasthya Kalyan Yojana (BSKY, Odisha)
schemes.description: Universal health assurance scheme of Government of Odisha providing cashless healthcare treatment in empaneled government and private hospitals.
schemes.beneficiaries: residents of Odisha, BPL and National/State Food Security Card holders
schemes.benefit: Cashless treatment up to ₹5 lakh per family per year, and up to ₹10 lakh per year for female members of the family.
schemes.eligibility: Groups: residents of Odisha, BPL and National/State Food Security Card holders
schemes.application_process: Card issued to all NFSA and SFSA cardholders; swipe BSKY smart card at any empaneled hospital helpdesk.
schemes.source_name: Government of Odisha — Health & Family Welfare

schemes.name: Chief Minister's Comprehensive Health Insurance Scheme (CMCHIS, Tamil Nadu)
schemes.description: Flagship healthcare assurance scheme of Government of Tamil Nadu providing cashless hospital treatment through public and private empaneled hospitals.
schemes.beneficiaries: resident families of Tamil Nadu, low income families, unorganised workers
schemes.benefit: Cashless hospitalization cover of up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year for 1,090 surgical and medical procedures including specialized surgeries and organ transplants.
schemes.eligibility: Max income: Rs 120,000; Groups: resident families of Tamil Nadu, low income families
schemes.application_process: Enroll at the District Collectorate CMCHIS kiosk with Smart Ration Card and Income Certificate to obtain CMCHIS biometric smart card.
schemes.source_name: Government of Tamil Nadu — Health & Family Welfare

schemes.name: Janani Shishu Suraksha Karyakram (JSSK)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
schemes.description: National Health Mission entitlement ensuring completely free and cashless delivery and healthcare for pregnant women and sick newborns in public health facilities.
schemes.beneficiaries: pregnant women, sick newborns, infants up to one year
schemes.benefit: Zero out-of-pocket expenses: free normal delivery and caesarean section, free drugs and consumables, free diagnostics, free diet, free blood, and free transport from home to facility and back.
schemes.eligibility: Groups: pregnant women, sick newborns
schemes.application_process: Universal entitlement at all public health facilities (District Hospitals, CHCs, PHCs); no formal application form is required.
schemes.source_name: National Health Mission — JSSK

schemes.name: Janani Suraksha Yojana (JSY)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
schemes.description: Safe motherhood intervention under the National Health Mission promoting institutional delivery among poor pregnant women to reduce maternal and neonatal mortality.
schemes.beneficiaries: pregnant women, mothers, BPL women, SC and ST women
schemes.benefit: Cash assistance of ₹1,400 in rural areas and ₹1,000 in urban areas for mothers in Low Performing States (LPS), along with incentives to ASHA workers.
schemes.eligibility: Groups: pregnant women, mothers
schemes.application_process: Register pregnancy at the local sub-centre, Primary Health Centre (PHC), or through community ASHA worker; cash benefit is disbursed upon institutional delivery.
schemes.source_name: National Health Mission — Janani Suraksha Yojana

schemes.name: Karunya Arogya Suraksha Padhathi (KASP, Kerala)
schemes.description: Comprehensive health insurance scheme implemented by Government of Kerala in convergence with AB-PMJAY to provide free tertiary and secondary care.
schemes.beneficiaries: vulnerable families in Kerala, existing RSBY and Karunya beneficiaries
schemes.benefit: Hospitalization insurance cover of ₹5,00,000 per family per year across empaneled public and private healthcare facilities in Kerala.
schemes.eligibility: Groups: vulnerable families in Kerala, existing RSBY and Karunya beneficiaries
schemes.application_process: Check family entitlement on the SHA Kerala portal with Ration Card number; collect KASP card from Akshaya centres.
schemes.source_name: State Health Agency Kerala — KASP

schemes.name: Mahatma Jyotirao Phule Jan Arogya Yojana (MJPJAY, Maharashtra)
schemes.department: Public Health Department / State Health Assurance Society
schemes.description: Flagship health insurance scheme of Government of Maharashtra providing cashless secondary and tertiary medical treatment through empaneled hospitals.
schemes.beneficiaries: citizens of Maharashtra holding valid ration cards, farmers in drought districts
schemes.benefit: Cashless medical and surgical cover of up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year for 1,356 identified surgical and medical therapies.
schemes.eligibility: Groups: citizens of Maharashtra holding valid ration cards, farmers in drought districts
schemes.application_process: Visit the Aarogyamitra kiosk at any network hospital with valid Ration Card and photo identity proof for pre-authorization.
schemes.source_name: State Health Assurance Society — MJPJAY

schemes.name: Ni-kshay Poshan Yojana (National TB Elimination Programme)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
schemes.description: Direct Benefit Transfer scheme under the National Tuberculosis Elimination Programme providing financial incentive to all notified TB patients for nutritional support.
schemes.beneficiaries: TB patients, notified tuberculosis patients
schemes.benefit: Direct cash assistance of ₹1,000 per month (transferred through DBT) for the entire duration of anti-tuberculosis treatment.
schemes.eligibility: Groups: TB patients, notified tuberculosis patients
schemes.application_process: Patient is notified on the Ni-kshay portal by the treating public health facility or private practitioner; bank details are recorded for DBT transfer.
schemes.source_name: National TB Elimination Programme — Ni-kshay Portal

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Bharatiya Janaushadhi Pariyojana (PMBJP)
schemes.department: Department of Pharmaceuticals / Pharmaceuticals and Medical Devices Bureau of India (PMBI)
schemes.description: Campaign launched by Department of Pharmaceuticals to make quality generic medicines available at affordable prices through dedicated Pradhan Mantri Bhartiya Janaushadhi Kendras.
schemes.beneficiaries: all citizens, patients needing chronic and acute medicines
schemes.benefit: Quality generic medicines and surgical products available at prices 50% to 90% lower than corresponding branded medicines.
schemes.eligibility: Groups: all citizens, patients needing chronic and acute medicines
schemes.application_process: Citizens purchase directly from any of the 10,000+ Jan Aushadhi Kendras across the country with a valid prescription.
schemes.source_name: Pharmaceuticals & Medical Devices Bureau of India — PMBJP

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri National Dialysis Programme (PMNDP)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
schemes.description: National Health Mission programme providing free haemodialysis services to below poverty line (BPL) kidney patients at district hospital dialysis centres.
schemes.beneficiaries: patients with chronic kidney disease, BPL patients, dialysis patients
schemes.benefit: 100% free haemodialysis sessions for BPL patients and subsidized rates for non-BPL patients through public-private partnership (PPP) centres in district hospitals.
schemes.eligibility: Groups: patients with chronic kidney disease, BPL patients
schemes.application_process: Register at the dialysis unit of the nearest Government District Hospital with physician prescription and BPL proof.
schemes.source_name: National Health Mission — Dialysis Services

schemes.name: Rashtriya Bal Swasthya Karyakram (RBSK)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
schemes.description: Child health screening and early intervention services under NHM covering 30 health conditions (4 Ds: Defects at birth, Deficiencies, Diseases, Development delays) from birth to 18 years.
schemes.beneficiaries: children aged 0 to 18 years, infants, school students, Anganwadi children
schemes.benefit: Free health screening, specialized treatment, and surgical interventions at District Early Intervention Centres (DEICs) and tertiary medical centres.
schemes.eligibility: Age: Any to 18 yrs; Groups: children aged 0 to 18 years, infants
schemes.application_process: Screenings conducted by Mobile Health Teams at Anganwadi Centres and government schools; identified children referred to DEICs.
schemes.source_name: National Health Mission — RBSK

schemes.name: Rashtriya Kishor Swasthya Karyakram (RKSK)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
schemes.description: Holistic adolescent health programme addressing nutrition, sexual and reproductive health, mental health, substance misuse, and non-communicable diseases.
schemes.beneficiaries: adolescents, youth aged 10 to 19 years
schemes.benefit: Free adolescent-friendly health clinics (Ujala Clinics), weekly iron and folic acid supplementation (WIFS), sanitary hygiene schemes, and peer counseling.
schemes.eligibility: Age: 10 to 19 yrs; Groups: adolescents, youth aged 10 to 19 years
schemes.application_process: Access services at Adolescent Friendly Health Clinics (AFHC) located at Primary Health Centres, CHCs, and District Hospitals.
schemes.source_name: National Health Mission — Adolescent Health

schemes.name: Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana - National Rural Livelihoods Mission (DAY-NRLM)
schemes.description: Flagship rural poverty reduction programme that organizes rural poor women into Self Help Groups (SHGs) and federations to promote diversified livelihoods and micro-enterprises.
schemes.beneficiaries: rural poor women, women self-help groups, marginalized rural households
schemes.benefit: Revolving Fund of ₹20,000–₹30,000 per SHG, Community Investment Fund (CIF) up to ₹2.5 lakh, and collateral-free bank loans up to ₹20 lakh with interest subvention down to 7%.
schemes.eligibility: Groups: rural poor women, women self-help groups
schemes.application_process: Join or form a village Self Help Group (SHG) facilitated by Community Resource Persons (CRPs) and Gram Panchayat Village Organizations.
schemes.source_name: National Rural Livelihoods Mission Portal

schemes.name: Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana - National Urban Livelihoods Mission (DAY-NULM)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
schemes.description: Mission to reduce poverty and vulnerability of urban poor households by enabling them to access gainful self-employment and skilled wage employment opportunities.
schemes.beneficiaries: urban poor, urban street vendors, urban homeless, women self-help groups
schemes.benefit: Subsidized interest rate of 7% on bank loans for micro-enterprises up to ₹2 lakh for individuals and ₹10 lakh for groups, free skill training, and revolving funds to Self Help Groups (SHGs).
schemes.eligibility: Groups: urban poor, urban street vendors
schemes.application_process: Apply through the City Mission Management Unit (CMMU) at the Municipal Corporation / Municipality or register through empaneled skill training providers.
schemes.source_name: National Urban Livelihoods Mission Portal

schemes.name: Jal Jeevan Mission (Har Ghar Jal)
schemes.department: Department of Drinking Water and Sanitation
schemes.description: National mission aimed at providing Functional Household Tap Connection (FHTC) to every rural household with safe and adequate drinking water.
schemes.beneficiaries: all rural households, rural families, Anganwadis and village schools
schemes.benefit: Functional household tap connection delivering 55 litres of potable water per person per day on a regular and long-term basis.
schemes.eligibility: Groups: all rural households, rural families
schemes.application_process: Community-led execution planned and maintained by Village Water and Sanitation Committees (VWSC) / Pani Samitis; households receive connection as part of village piped scheme.
schemes.source_name: Jal Jeevan Mission National Portal

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana-Gramin (PMAY-G)
schemes.description: Centrally sponsored rural housing programme providing financial assistance to houseless rural households and those living in dilapidated houses to construct disaster-resilient pucca homes.
schemes.beneficiaries: rural houseless households, kutcha house dwellers, SC and ST rural families, destitute families
schemes.benefit: Grant assistance of ₹1,20,000 in plains and ₹1,30,000 in hilly/difficult/IAP areas, along with 90–95 days of unskilled labour under MGNREGA and ₹12,000 for toilet construction.
schemes.eligibility: Groups: rural houseless households, kutcha house dwellers
schemes.application_process: Beneficiaries are identified from the SECC-2011 Permanent Wait List and Awaas+ list verified by Gram Sabha; geo-tagged milestones trigger direct account transfers.
schemes.source_name: PMAY-G Official Portal

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana — Urban 2.0 (PMAY-U 2.0)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
schemes.description: Flagship urban housing mission providing central assistance to eligible urban poor, Economically Weaker Section (EWS), Low Income Group (LIG), and Middle Income Group (MIG) families to construct or purchase pucca houses.
schemes.beneficiaries: urban households, economically weaker sections, low income groups, slum dwellers
schemes.benefit: Interest subsidy on home loans (up to ₹1.80 lakh), beneficiary-led construction subsidy of ₹2.5 lakh, or affordable housing in partnership support.
schemes.eligibility: Groups: urban households, economically weaker sections
schemes.application_process: Apply online at pmay-urban.gov.in under Citizen Assessment or through local Urban Local Body (ULB) / Municipal Corporation office.
schemes.source_name: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs — PMAY-U

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Gram Sadak Yojana (PMGSY)
schemes.description: Centrally sponsored scheme to provide all-weather road connectivity to eligible unconnected habitations in rural areas.
schemes.beneficiaries: rural habitations, farmers, village residents
schemes.benefit: All-weather paved road connecting unconnected rural villages to the nearest highway or market centre, facilitating transport of produce and access to services.
schemes.eligibility: Groups: rural habitations, farmers
schemes.application_process: Habitation-level planning conducted via District Rural Road Plans (DRRP) approved by Panchayati Raj Institutions and State governments.
schemes.source_name: Online Management, Monitoring and Accounting System (OMMAS) — PMGSY

schemes.name: Swachh Bharat Mission (Grameen) — Individual Household Latrine (IHHL)
schemes.department: Department of Drinking Water and Sanitation
schemes.description: Flagship sanitation campaign providing financial incentives to rural households for the construction and sustained use of individual household latrines (IHHL).
schemes.beneficiaries: rural households without toilets, BPL households, SC and ST rural families, small farmers
schemes.benefit: Direct financial incentive of ₹12,000 for construction of a functional twin-pit pour-flush individual household toilet.
schemes.eligibility: Groups: rural households without toilets, BPL households
schemes.application_process: Apply online via sbm.gov.in under Citizen Corner or submit application through the Gram Panchayat Secretary / Swachhagrahi.
schemes.source_name: Swachh Bharat Mission — Grameen Portal

schemes.name: Swachh Bharat Mission (Urban) — Individual Household Toilets
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
schemes.description: Urban sanitation programme supporting urban slum dwellers and informal settlement residents to build individual sanitary latrines and eliminate open defecation.
schemes.beneficiaries: urban slum dwellers, informal settlers without toilet, economically weaker urban families
schemes.benefit: Financial incentive of up to ₹4,000 to ₹10,000 (combining Central and State/ULB shares) for constructing an individual household toilet in urban areas.
schemes.eligibility: Groups: urban slum dwellers, informal settlers without toilet
schemes.application_process: Apply online at the official portal or visit the ward office of the local Urban Local Body (ULB).
schemes.source_name: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs — Swachh Bharat Urban

schemes.name: PM YASASVI - Top Class Education Scholarship
schemes.description: Scholarship support for eligible OBC, EBC and DNT students pursuing higher education.
schemes.beneficiaries: General public
schemes.benefit: Financial assistance for eligible educational expenses.
schemes.eligibility: Age: 17 to 30 yrs; Max income: Rs 250,000; Education: Undergraduate; Employment: Student
schemes.application_process: Refer to official portal
schemes.source_name: Unspecified Source

schemes.name: PM YASASVI - Top Class Education in College for OBC, EBC and DNT Students
schemes.description: Central Sector scholarship scheme providing financial assistance to eligible OBC, EBC and DNT students pursuing higher education in notified institutions.
schemes.beneficiaries: General public
schemes.benefit: Financial assistance including tuition fee and other eligible educational expenses, subject to the scheme guidelines and applicable limits.
schemes.eligibility: Max income: Rs 250,000; Education: Undergraduate; Employment: Student
schemes.application_process: Refer to official portal
schemes.source_name: Unspecified Source

schemes.name: Annapurna Scheme (Food Security for Indigent Senior Citizens)
schemes.abbreviation: Food Security for Indigent Senior Citizens
schemes.department: Department of Food and Public Distribution / NSAP
schemes.description: Component under NSAP providing 10 kg of food grains per month free of cost to indigent senior citizens who, though eligible, remain uncovered under IGNOAPS.
schemes.beneficiaries: indigent senior citizens aged 65 and above without pension
schemes.benefit: 10 kilograms of food grains (rice/wheat) per month completely free through the Targeted Public Distribution System (TPDS) fair price shops.
schemes.eligibility: Age: 65 to Any yrs; Groups: indigent senior citizens aged 65 and above without pension
schemes.application_process: Identified by District Administration / Food and Civil Supplies Department; special Annapurna ration cards are issued.
schemes.source_name: NSAP Portal — Annapurna

schemes.name: Atal Vayo Abhyuday Yojana (AVYAY)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
schemes.department: Department of Social Justice and Empowerment
schemes.description: Umbrella scheme supporting quality of life, care, shelter, health and active ageing of senior citizens through components and implementing agencies. Archived component.
schemes.beneficiaries: senior citizens, older persons
schemes.benefit: Services and support varied by component and implementing agency under legacy guidelines; earlier components have been restructured into dedicated national initiatives.
schemes.eligibility: Groups: senior citizens, older persons
schemes.application_process: Archived scheme component; check current restructured social justice schemes.
schemes.source_name: Department of Social Justice and Empowerment — AVYAY Archive

schemes.name: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (IGNOAPS)
schemes.description: Sub-scheme under NSAP providing monthly non-contributory old age pension to persons aged 60 years or above living below the poverty line.
schemes.beneficiaries: senior citizens aged 60 and above, BPL elderly
schemes.benefit: Monthly pension of ₹200 (for age 60–79 years) and ₹500 (for age 80 years and above) provided by Central Government, with additional state contributions varying from ₹500 to ₹2,500/month.
