schemes.eligibility: Age: 60 to Any yrs; Groups: senior citizens aged 60 and above, BPL elderly
schemes.application_process: Apply through the Gram Panchayat / BDO office in rural areas or Municipal Municipality office in urban areas, or online via NSAP portal.
schemes.source_name: NSAP Portal — IGNOAPS

schemes.name: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (Sikkim)
schemes.description: Sikkim state pension scheme for older residents delivering social security to senior citizens living below poverty line in Sikkim.
schemes.beneficiaries: older persons, senior citizens in Sikkim
schemes.benefit: Monthly pension of ₹1,000 (Central + Sikkim state share) directly credited to elderly residents' bank accounts.
schemes.eligibility: Age: 60 to Any yrs; Groups: older persons, senior citizens in Sikkim
schemes.application_process: Apply through the Gram Vikas Adhikari / Block Administrative Centre or online via the Sikkim Pension portal.
schemes.source_name: Government of Sikkim — Pension Scheme

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Vaya Vandana Yojana (PMVVY)
schemes.description: Government pension programme for senior citizens aged 60 years and above managed by Life Insurance Corporation of India (LIC). Officially closed for new subscription on 31 March 2023.
schemes.beneficiaries: senior citizens aged 60 and above
schemes.benefit: Assured pension payout of 7.4% per annum for 10 years on purchase price up to ₹15 lakh; ongoing payouts continue for existing subscribers until tenure completion.
schemes.eligibility: Age: 60 to Any yrs; Groups: senior citizens aged 60 and above
schemes.application_process: Scheme closed for fresh enrollment on 31st March 2023. Existing policyholders service accounts through LIC branches.
schemes.source_name: Department of Financial Services — PMVVY

schemes.name: Sandhya Suraksha Yojana (Karnataka)
schemes.department: Revenue Department / Directorate of Social Security and Pensions
schemes.description: Social security pension scheme of the Government of Karnataka providing financial security and dignity to elderly citizens from weaker sections.
schemes.beneficiaries: senior citizens aged 65 and above, elderly persons in low income households
schemes.benefit: Monthly financial pension of ₹1,200 transferred directly through DBT to the elderly beneficiary's bank account.
schemes.eligibility: Age: 65 to Any yrs; Max income: Rs 20,000; Groups: senior citizens aged 65 and above, elderly persons in low income households
schemes.application_process: Apply at Nadakacheri (Atalji Janasnehi Kendra) or through Seva Sindhu centres in Karnataka.
schemes.source_name: Government of Karnataka Official Portal

schemes.name: Atal Pension Yojana (APY)
schemes.department: Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority (PFRDA)
schemes.description: Government of India guaranteed pension scheme for all citizens in the unorganised sector administered by PFRDA through all banks and post offices.
schemes.beneficiaries: unorganised sector workers, all citizens aged 18-40 years, non-taxpayers
schemes.benefit: Guaranteed minimum monthly pension of ₹1,000, ₹2,000, ₹3,000, ₹4,000, or ₹5,000 after attaining 60 years of age, depending on contribution.
schemes.eligibility: Age: 18 to 40 yrs; Groups: unorganised sector workers, all citizens aged 18-40 years
schemes.application_process: Apply at any bank branch or post office where you maintain a savings account, or enroll via mobile banking / net banking portal.
schemes.source_name: Department of Financial Services — Atal Pension Yojana

schemes.name: Free Coaching Scheme for SC and OBC Students
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
schemes.department: Department of Social Justice and Empowerment
schemes.description: Central Sector Scheme providing coaching of good quality to meritorious SC and OBC candidates to enable them to compete in competitive examinations for civil services, engineering, medical, and banking jobs.
schemes.beneficiaries: SC candidates, OBC candidates, graduates appearing for competitive exams
schemes.benefit: Full coaching fee paid directly to empaneled premier coaching institutes plus monthly stipend of ₹4,000 for local students and ₹6,000 for outstation students.
schemes.eligibility: Max income: Rs 800,000; Groups: SC candidates, OBC candidates
schemes.application_process: Apply online at coaching.dosje.gov.in during the annual application cycle; selection based on academic merit in Class 12 or graduation.
schemes.source_name: Coaching Schemes Portal — MoSJE

schemes.name: Kerala Agricultural Workers Pension Scheme
schemes.description: Statutory social security pension scheme providing monthly pension to elderly agricultural labourers who have worked in Kerala agricultural lands.
schemes.beneficiaries: elderly agricultural workers, farm labourers aged 60 and above
schemes.benefit: Monthly direct pension of ₹1,600 transferred directly into the bank accounts of registered agricultural workers.
schemes.eligibility: Age: 60 to Any yrs; Max income: Rs 100,000; Groups: elderly agricultural workers, farm labourers aged 60 and above
schemes.application_process: Apply through the local Grama Panchayat / Municipality office with certification of agricultural labour from the Agricultural Officer.
schemes.source_name: Government of Kerala Official Portal

schemes.name: National Family Benefit Scheme (NFBS)
schemes.description: NSAP component providing immediate lump sum financial relief to a below-poverty-line household upon the death of the primary breadwinner.
schemes.beneficiaries: bereaved BPL households, families losing primary breadwinner
schemes.benefit: One-time lump sum grant of ₹20,000 transferred to the surviving head of the household upon the death of the primary breadwinner aged between 18 and 59 years.
schemes.eligibility: Groups: bereaved BPL households, families losing primary breadwinner
schemes.application_process: Submit application within six months of the breadwinner's death to the Sub-Divisional Magistrate (SDM) / BDO / Municipal office.
schemes.source_name: NSAP Portal — NFBS

schemes.name: National Social Assistance Programme (NSAP)
schemes.description: Centrally sponsored scheme comprising five sub-schemes that provides social security pensions and financial assistance to destitute senior citizens, widows, disabled persons, and bereaved BPL families.
schemes.beneficiaries: destitute elderly, widows, persons with severe disabilities, bereaved BPL families
schemes.benefit: Regular monthly direct benefit transfer pension and one-time family bereavement support administered in partnership with State Governments.
schemes.eligibility: Groups: destitute elderly, widows
schemes.application_process: Apply online via nsap.nic.in, Umang mobile app, or submit physical application to the Block Development Officer (BDO) or Municipal Ward Officer.
schemes.source_name: National Social Assistance Programme Portal

schemes.name: PM DAKSH (Pradhan Mantri Dakshta Aur Kushalta Sampann Hitgrahi)
schemes.abbreviation: Pradhan Mantri Dakshta Aur Kushalta Sampann Hitgrahi
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
schemes.description: National Action Plan providing completely free multi-skilling and up-skilling training to SC, OBC, EBC, DNT youth, and sanitation workers to enhance self-employment and wage placement.
schemes.beneficiaries: SC youth, OBC youth, economically backward classes, sanitation workers and ragpickers
schemes.benefit: 100% free skill development training, stipend of ₹1,000–₹1,500/month during non-residential training, wage compensation of ₹2,500 for upskilling, and placement assistance.
schemes.eligibility: Age: 18 to 45 yrs; Groups: SC youth, OBC youth
schemes.application_process: Register online at pmdaksh.dosje.gov.in or through the PM-DAKSH mobile application, select training partner and preferred job role.
schemes.source_name: PM DAKSH Official Portal

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Anusuchit Jaati Abhyuday Yojna (PM-AJAY)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
schemes.department: Department of Social Justice and Empowerment
schemes.description: Centrally sponsored scheme merging three erstwhile schemes to provide socio-economic development, skill training, and infrastructure to Scheduled Caste majority villages and families.
schemes.beneficiaries: Scheduled Caste households, SC majority villages, SC youth
schemes.benefit: Grants for socio-economic infrastructure in SC majority villages (Adarsh Gram component), income-generating grants up to ₹50,000 or 50% of project cost, and construction of hostel facilities.
schemes.eligibility: Groups: Scheduled Caste households, SC majority villages
schemes.application_process: Implemented via State Social Welfare Departments and District Welfare Officers in selected village clusters.
schemes.source_name: Department of Social Justice and Empowerment — PM-AJAY

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana (PMJDY)
schemes.description: National mission for comprehensive financial inclusion ensuring universal access to banking facilities with at least one basic banking account for every unbanked household.
schemes.beneficiaries: unbanked citizens, low income households, rural and urban adults
schemes.benefit: Zero balance savings account with no minimum balance penalty, free RuPay debit card with inbuilt ₹2,00,000 accident insurance cover, and overdraft facility up to ₹10,000.
schemes.eligibility: Age: 10 to Any yrs; Groups: unbanked citizens, low income households
schemes.application_process: Open a basic savings bank deposit account (BSBDA) at any bank branch or Bank Mitra / Business Correspondent outlet with valid KYC.
schemes.source_name: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana National Portal

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY)
schemes.description: Government-backed one-year renewable term life insurance scheme offering life insurance cover for death due to any reason at an affordable annual premium.
schemes.beneficiaries: bank account holders aged 18 to 50 years, citizens seeking life insurance
schemes.benefit: Life risk cover of ₹2,00,000 payable to the nominee upon the death of the insured member due to any cause, for a modest annual premium of ₹436.
schemes.eligibility: Age: 18 to 50 yrs; Groups: bank account holders aged 18 to 50 years, citizens seeking life insurance
schemes.application_process: Enroll by giving auto-debit consent through your bank branch, post office, or online through net banking / mobile banking app.
schemes.source_name: Department of Financial Services — PMJJBY

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY)
schemes.description: Government-sponsored one-year accident insurance scheme providing cover for accidental death and permanent disability at a nominal annual premium of ₹20.
schemes.beneficiaries: bank account holders aged 18 to 70 years, citizens seeking accident cover
schemes.benefit: Accidental death and total permanent disability cover of ₹2,00,000, and permanent partial disability cover of ₹1,00,000 for an annual premium of ₹20.
schemes.eligibility: Age: 18 to 70 yrs; Groups: bank account holders aged 18 to 70 years, citizens seeking accident cover
schemes.application_process: Submit consent-cum-declaration form at your bank/post office branch or activate instantly via net banking or SMS facility.
schemes.source_name: Department of Financial Services — PMSBY

schemes.name: Sanjay Gandhi Niradhar Anudan Yojana (Maharashtra)
schemes.department: Social Justice and Special Assistance Department
schemes.description: Social assistance scheme of the Government of Maharashtra providing monthly financial assistance to destitute persons, widows, and severely disabled persons.
schemes.beneficiaries: destitute persons, widows, severely disabled persons, orphan children
schemes.benefit: Monthly financial allowance of ₹1,500 per month (₹1,500 for single beneficiary; ₹2,500 for family with multiple eligible dependents).
schemes.eligibility: Max income: Rs 21,000; Groups: destitute persons, widows
schemes.application_process: Apply at the Taluk Tahsildar office or online via Aaple Sarkar portal in Maharashtra.
schemes.source_name: Social Justice Department Maharashtra — Sanjay Gandhi Scheme

schemes.name: Scheme for Residential Education for Students in High Schools in Targeted Areas (SHRESHTA)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
schemes.department: Department of Social Justice and Empowerment
schemes.description: Central Sector Scheme providing high quality residential school education in premier private CBSE-affiliated residential schools to meritorious Scheduled Caste boys and girls.
schemes.beneficiaries: Scheduled Caste school students in Class 8 and 10
schemes.benefit: Full tuition fees, hostel expenses, mess charges, and uniform/books allowance directly paid by the Ministry for Classes IX to XII.
schemes.eligibility: Max income: Rs 250,000; Groups: Scheduled Caste school students in Class 8 and 10
schemes.application_process: Apply and appear for the National Entrance Test for SHRESHTA (NETS) conducted nationwide by the National Testing Agency (NTA).
schemes.source_name: Department of Social Justice and Empowerment — SHRESHTA

schemes.name: Support for Marginalized Individuals for Livelihood and Enterprise (SMILE)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
schemes.description: Comprehensive umbrella scheme of Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment providing rehabilitation, healthcare, counseling, and skill development to transgender persons and persons engaged in begging.
schemes.beneficiaries: transgender persons, persons engaged in the act of begging, marginalized individuals
schemes.benefit: National portal for transgender certificates, Garima Greh (shelter homes with food and clothing), composite medical health insurance cover of ₹5 lakh, and skill development scholarships.
schemes.eligibility: Groups: transgender persons, persons engaged in the act of begging
schemes.application_process: Transgender persons register online at transgender.dosje.gov.in without physical interface to obtain Transgender Certificate and Identity Card issued by District Magistrate.
schemes.source_name: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment — SMILE

schemes.name: Venture Capital Fund for Scheduled Castes (VCF-SC)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
schemes.description: First-of-its-kind venture fund initiated by Government of India and managed by IFCI Venture to promote entrepreneurship among Scheduled Castes and provide concessional finance.
schemes.beneficiaries: Scheduled Caste entrepreneurs, SC-owned companies, SC startups
schemes.benefit: Equity, preference shares, and debentures funding ranging from ₹20 lakh up to ₹15 crore per SC-owned enterprise with concessional return expectations.
schemes.eligibility: Groups: Scheduled Caste entrepreneurs, SC-owned companies
schemes.application_process: Submit business proposal and Detailed Project Report (DPR) online on vcfsc.in to IFCI Venture Capital Funds Ltd.
schemes.source_name: Department of Social Justice and Empowerment — VCF-SC

schemes.name: PM-KISAN Samman Nidhi
schemes.description: Preliminary match for landholding farmer families. Final eligibility is determined by the State/UT under PM-KISAN guidelines; statutory exclusion categories and e-KYC/document checks still apply.
schemes.beneficiaries: General public
schemes.benefit: Income support of ₹6,000 per year in three equal instalments for eligible landholding farmer families.
schemes.eligibility: See official scheme guidelines
schemes.application_process: Refer to official portal
schemes.source_name: Unspecified Source

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Urban 2.0 (PMAY-U 2.0)
schemes.description: Preliminary match for an urban household without a pucca house. Final eligibility depends on the selected PMAY-U 2.0 vertical, family-wide house ownership and prior-allotment checks.
schemes.beneficiaries: General public
schemes.benefit: Housing assistance under eligible PMAY-U 2.0 verticals; assistance and subsidy vary by vertical, location and approved project.
schemes.eligibility: See official scheme guidelines
schemes.application_process: Refer to official portal
schemes.source_name: Unspecified Source

schemes.name: Beti Bachao Beti Padhao (BBBP)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Women and Child Development
schemes.department: Beti Bachao Beti Padhao Task Force
schemes.description: Joint initiative of MWCD, MoHFW, and MoE addressing declining Child Sex Ratio (CSR) and promoting girls' education, health, and social rights.
schemes.beneficiaries: girl children, adolescent girls, families with daughter
schemes.benefit: Comprehensive district-level community mobilization, institutional incentives, secondary education enrollment drives, and sports scholarships for girls.
schemes.eligibility: Groups: girl children, adolescent girls
schemes.application_process: Community-wide programme executed through District Collectors, schools, and Anganwadis; individual services linked to education and health facilities.
schemes.source_name: Ministry of Women and Child Development — BBBP

schemes.name: Destitute Widow Pension Scheme (Tamil Nadu)
schemes.description: Social security scheme of Government of Tamil Nadu providing monthly pension and free clothing to destitute widows with no adult earning children.
schemes.beneficiaries: destitute widows, unsupported women
schemes.benefit: Monthly financial pension of ₹1,000 plus free supply of two sarees per year (on Pongal and Deepavali festivals) and free bus travel passes.
schemes.eligibility: Age: 18 to Any yrs; Groups: destitute widows, unsupported women
schemes.application_process: Apply online at the nearest e-Sevai Centre or submit application to the Special Tahsildar (Social Security Scheme).
schemes.source_name: Government of Tamil Nadu — Social Security Pensions

schemes.name: Dr. Muthulakshmi Reddy Maternity Benefit Scheme (Tamil Nadu)
schemes.department: Public Health and Preventive Medicine Department
schemes.description: Tamil Nadu state maternal health scheme providing financial assistance and nutritional kits to poor pregnant women before and after institutional delivery.
schemes.beneficiaries: pregnant women, lactating mothers, BPL mothers
schemes.benefit: Total assistance of ₹18,000 per beneficiary: cash assistance of ₹14,000 in five instalments via DBT and two Amma Maternity Nutrition Kits valued at ₹4,000.
schemes.eligibility: Age: 19 to Any yrs; Groups: pregnant women, lactating mothers
schemes.application_process: Pre-register pregnancy on PICME (Pregnancy and Infant Cohort Monitoring and Evaluation) portal via Village Health Nurse (VHN) before 12 weeks.
schemes.source_name: Government of Tamil Nadu — PICME Portal

schemes.name: Gruha Lakshmi Scheme (Karnataka)
schemes.department: Department of Women and Child Development
schemes.description: One of the five flagship guarantees of the Government of Karnataka, providing direct financial assistance to female heads of families.
schemes.beneficiaries: women heads of family, Antyodaya, BPL and APL ration card holders
schemes.benefit: Monthly direct cash benefit of ₹2,000 transferred via DBT to the Aadhaar-linked bank accounts of eligible women heads of households.
schemes.eligibility: Groups: women heads of family, Antyodaya, BPL and APL ration card holders
schemes.application_process: Apply online at Seva Sindhu portal or through Karnataka One, Grama One, and Bangalore One citizen centres.
schemes.source_name: Government of Karnataka — Seva Sindhu Portal

schemes.name: Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme (IGNWPS)
schemes.description: Sub-scheme under NSAP providing monthly financial assistance and dignity to destitute widows aged 40–59 years living below the poverty line.
schemes.beneficiaries: widows aged 40 to 59 years, BPL widows, destitute women
schemes.benefit: Monthly central pension of ₹300 per month (supplemented with additional state top-up allowances ranging from ₹700 to ₹2,200/month) directly credited to the beneficiary's bank account.
schemes.eligibility: Age: 40 to 59 yrs; Groups: widows aged 40 to 59 years, BPL widows
schemes.application_process: Submit application at the Block Development Office or Municipal office with death certificate of the spouse and BPL proof.
schemes.source_name: NSAP Portal — IGNWPS

schemes.name: Kalaignar Magalir Urimai Thittam (KMUT)
schemes.department: Special Programme Implementation Department / Revenue Department
schemes.description: Pioneering rights-based social assistance scheme of the Government of Tamil Nadu providing monthly financial grant to eligible women heads of households.
schemes.beneficiaries: women heads of family, rural women, women in low income households
schemes.benefit: Monthly cash support of ₹1,000 transferred directly through DBT into the bank accounts of eligible women family heads.
schemes.eligibility: Age: 21 to Any yrs; Max income: Rs 250,000; Groups: women heads of family, rural women
schemes.application_process: Apply during special camp drives at neighborhood ration fair price shops or submit application at e-Sevai centres.
schemes.source_name: Government of Tamil Nadu — KMUT Portal

schemes.name: Mission Shakti
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Women and Child Development
schemes.description: Integrated umbrella programme for safety, security, and empowerment of women, implemented through Sambal (safety and security) and Samarthya (empowerment) sub-schemes.
schemes.beneficiaries: women, women in distress, working women, female youth
schemes.benefit: Comprehensive institutional support including One Stop Centres, Women Helplines (181), Beti Bachao Beti Padhao, Shakti Sadan, and Working Women Hostels.
schemes.eligibility: Groups: women, women in distress
schemes.application_process: Services accessed through District Women and Child Development offices, One Stop Centres, and dedicated helpline 181.
schemes.source_name: Ministry of Women and Child Development — Mission Shakti

schemes.name: Mission Vatsalya (Child Protection Services)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Women and Child Development
schemes.description: Centrally sponsored roadmap for child welfare and child protection services, supporting children in difficult circumstances and non-institutional foster care.
schemes.beneficiaries: orphans, children in need of care and protection, destitute children, foster families
schemes.benefit: Financial support of ₹4,000 per month per child under sponsorship / foster care for vulnerable children, plus care in Child Care Institutions (CCIs).
schemes.eligibility: Age: Any to 18 yrs; Groups: orphans, children in need of care and protection
schemes.application_process: Applications for sponsorship are submitted to the District Child Protection Unit (DCPU) or Child Welfare Committee (CWC).
schemes.source_name: Ministry of Women and Child Development — Mission Vatsalya

schemes.name: Moovalur Ramamirtham Ammaiyar Ninaivu Marriage Assistance Scheme (Tamil Nadu)
schemes.department: Department of Social Welfare and Women Empowerment
schemes.description: State financial assistance scheme to help poor parents educate their daughters up to marriageable age and provide marriage grants with 8 grams of gold coin.
schemes.beneficiaries: poor brides, daughters of low income families
schemes.benefit: Financial grant of ₹25,000 (for Class X passed) or ₹50,000 (for degree/diploma holders) plus a sovereign (8 grams) 22-carat gold coin (Thirumangalyam) for marriage.
schemes.eligibility: Age: 18 to Any yrs; Max income: Rs 72,000; Groups: poor brides, daughters of low income families
schemes.application_process: Apply online through e-Sevai centres or at the Block Development Office at least 40 days prior to the wedding date.
schemes.source_name: Tamil Nadu Social Welfare — Marriage Assistance

schemes.name: Mukhyamantri Majhi Ladki Bahin Yojana (Maharashtra)
schemes.description: Direct benefit transfer scheme of the Government of Maharashtra providing economic empowerment and self-reliance to women aged 21–65 years.
schemes.beneficiaries: women residents of Maharashtra, low income women
schemes.benefit: Monthly financial assistance of ₹1,500 transferred directly to the Aadhaar-linked bank accounts of eligible women.
schemes.eligibility: Age: 21 to 65 yrs; Max income: Rs 250,000; Groups: women residents of Maharashtra, low income women
schemes.application_process: Apply online at ladakibahin.maharashtra.gov.in, via Nari Shakti Doot mobile app, or at Setu Suvidha / Anganwadi centres.
schemes.source_name: Government of Maharashtra — Ladki Bahin Portal

schemes.name: National Scheme of Incentive to Girls for Secondary Education (NSIGSE)
schemes.department: Department of School Education and Literacy
schemes.description: Centrally sponsored scheme to promote enrollment of girl children in secondary schools and reduce drop-out rates. Currently undergoing national portal restructuring and guideline review.
schemes.beneficiaries: unmarried SC and ST girls, Kasturba Gandhi Balika Vidyalaya passouts
schemes.benefit: Fixed deposit of ₹3,000 in the name of eligible girl child on enrollment in Class IX, withdrawable with interest on attaining 18 years and passing Class X.
schemes.eligibility: Age: 14 to 16 yrs; Groups: unmarried SC and ST girls, Kasturba Gandhi Balika Vidyalaya passouts
schemes.application_process: Undergoing national portal integration; historically verified through State education departments and National Scholarship Portal.
schemes.source_name: Ministry of Education — NSIGSE

schemes.name: One Stop Centre Scheme (Sakhi Centres)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Women and Child Development
schemes.description: Centrally sponsored scheme providing integrated support and assistance under one roof to women affected by violence in private and public spaces.
schemes.beneficiaries: women facing violence, girls facing abuse, women in distress
schemes.benefit: Free emergency response, medical assistance, assistance in filing FIR/NCR, legal counseling, psychological counseling, and temporary shelter up to 5 days.
schemes.eligibility: Groups: women facing violence, girls facing abuse
schemes.application_process: Walk into any designated One Stop Centre (located in district headquarters/district hospitals) or access via toll-free helpline 181.
schemes.source_name: Ministry of Women and Child Development — One Stop Centre

schemes.name: Poshan Abhiyaan (National Nutrition Mission)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Women and Child Development
schemes.description: Government of India's flagship programme to improve nutritional outcomes for children under 6 years, pregnant women, and lactating mothers.
schemes.beneficiaries: children aged 0-6 years, pregnant women, lactating mothers, adolescent girls
schemes.benefit: Supplementary nutrition at Anganwadi Centres, growth monitoring using Poshan Tracker, micro-nutrient fortification, and anemia prevention counseling.
schemes.eligibility: Groups: children aged 0-6 years, pregnant women
schemes.application_process: Register at the neighborhood Anganwadi Centre; health workers track growth parameters via the Poshan Tracker app.
schemes.source_name: Poshan Abhiyaan Official Portal

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Women and Child Development
schemes.description: Centrally sponsored conditional cash transfer scheme providing financial incentive to pregnant women and lactating mothers for health-seeking behaviour and compensation for wage loss.
schemes.beneficiaries: pregnant women, lactating mothers, socially and economically disadvantaged women
schemes.benefit: Direct cash transfer of ₹5,000 in two instalments for the first living child, and ₹6,000 in a single instalment upon the birth of a second child if the child is a girl.
schemes.eligibility: Groups: pregnant women, lactating mothers
schemes.application_process: Register online at pmmvy.wcd.gov.in or submit application Form 1A/1B at the local Anganwadi Centre / approved health facility within 270 days of LMP.
schemes.source_name: Ministry of Women and Child Development — PMMVY Portal

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas
schemes.description: Flagship scheme providing deposit-free LPG connections to adult women from poor households to safeguard family health from indoor air pollution.
schemes.beneficiaries: adult women from poor households, BPL households, SC and ST households, PM Awas beneficiaries
schemes.benefit: Free deposit-free LPG connection, free first LPG cylinder refill, free hotplate (stove), and targeted subsidy of ₹300 per 14.2 kg cylinder for up to 12 refills/year.
schemes.eligibility: Age: 18 to Any yrs; Groups: adult women from poor households, BPL households
schemes.application_process: Apply online at pmuy.gov.in or submit Ujjwala 2.0 application form at the nearest LPG distributor (Indane, Bharatgas, or HP Gas).
schemes.source_name: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana Official Portal

schemes.name: Shakti Sadan
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Women and Child Development
schemes.description: Integrated relief and rehabilitation home providing shelter, food, clothing, counseling, medical care, and vocational training to women in difficult circumstances.
schemes.beneficiaries: women in distress, trafficked women, victims of violence, destitute women
schemes.benefit: Free institutional shelter, legal aid, mental health support, and livelihood skill development for trafficked women, victims of domestic violence, and destitute women.
schemes.eligibility: Groups: women in distress, trafficked women
schemes.application_process: Admission via referral from One Stop Centres, police, Women Helplines, Child Welfare Committees, or direct application to the superintendent.
schemes.source_name: Ministry of Women and Child Development — Shakti Sadan

schemes.name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY)
schemes.department: Department of Economic Affairs / National Savings Institute
schemes.description: Government of India backed small deposit savings scheme targeted at parents of girl children to build a fund for higher education and marriage.
schemes.beneficiaries: girl children up to 10 years of age, parents of girl children
schemes.benefit: Attractive sovereign-guaranteed interest rate (8.2% p.a.), exempt-exempt-exempt (EEE) tax benefit under Section 80C, with account maturity 21 years from opening.
schemes.eligibility: Age: Any to 10 yrs; Groups: girl children up to 10 years of age, parents of girl children
schemes.application_process: Open an account at any Post Office or authorized commercial bank branch before the girl child turns 10 years of age with initial deposit of minimum ₹250.
schemes.source_name: National Savings Institute — Sukanya Samriddhi

schemes.name: Working Women Hostel Scheme (Sakhi Niwas)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Women and Child Development
schemes.description: Mission Shakti scheme providing safe and conveniently located accommodation with daycare facilities for working women in urban and semi-urban areas.
schemes.beneficiaries: working women, single women, widows, women undergoing job training
schemes.benefit: Subsidized secure lodging, food, and day-care facilities for children up to 18 years (girls) and up to 5 years (boys) of working women.
schemes.eligibility: Groups: working women, single women
schemes.application_process: Apply directly to the management committee of the local Sakhi Niwas / Working Women Hostel running under the State/Municipal authority.
schemes.source_name: Ministry of Women and Child Development — Working Women Hostel
